usage.query:
SELECT
  s.id AS sessionId,
  CAST(strftime('%s', s.created_at) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS timestamp,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(CASE WHEN json_valid(s.model_config_json) = 1 THEN json_extract(s.model_config_json, '$.model_name') END, ''), 'unknown') AS model,
  'unknown' AS project,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.accumulated_input_tokens, s.input_tokens, 0) AS INTEGER) AS inputTokens,
  0 AS cachedInputTokens,
  0 AS cacheCreationInputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.accumulated_output_tokens, s.output_tokens, 0) AS INTEGER) AS outputTokens,
  CAST(MAX(0, COALESCE(s.accumulated_total_tokens, s.total_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(s.accumulated_input_tokens, s.input_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(s.accumulated_output_tokens, s.output_tokens, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS reasoningOutputTokens
FROM sessions s
WHERE json_valid(s.model_config_json) = 1
  AND trim(json_extract(s.model_config_json, '$.model_name')) <> ''
  AND (COALESCE(s.accumulated_total_tokens, s.total_tokens, 0) > 0
       OR COALESCE(s.accumulated_input_tokens, s.input_tokens, 0) > 0
       OR COALESCE(s.accumulated_output_tokens, s.output_tokens, 0) > 0)
